property_summary: After a call to fallback with 10 ether when block.number%15!=0 and block.timestamp>pastBlockTime, the reference transfers balance to caller and sets pastBlockTime to block.timestamp; the bug transfers when block.number%15==0 instead, so pastBlockTime differs after the call.

After three fallback calls with 10 ether at block numbers 1, 15, and 2, the reference contract (transfers at block%15==0) ends with pastBlockTime = timestamp of block 15, while the buggy version (transfers at block%15!=0) ends with pastBlockTime = timestamp of block 2, causing the assertTrue(c.pastBlockTime() == timestampOfBlock15) to pass for reference but fail for the bug.
